title: Rate Schedule Note: Graduated Per-Worker Rates by Enrolled Workforce
content:
Under the employer-paid fee model of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement the workers are billed in graduated bands of the month's enrolled active workers on the census:

- where they exceed 5000, the first 1000 workers are billed at the tier's per-worker monthly fee, the workers above 1000 up to 5000 at 0.85 of it (85 percent) and the workers above 5000 at 0.7 of it (70 percent);
- where they exceed 1000 but not 5000, the first 1000 workers are billed at the tier's per-worker monthly fee and the rest at 0.85 of it;
- otherwise every enrolled worker is billed at the tier's per-worker monthly fee.

| Enrolled active workers | First 1000 | Workers 1001 to 5000 | Workers above 5000 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1000 or fewer | full fee for each | none | none |
| 1001 to 5000 | full fee | 85 percent of the fee | none |
| more than 5000 | full fee | 85 percent of the fee | 70 percent of the fee |

## Boundaries

Exactly 1000 enrolled workers are all billed at the full fee; at 1001 the 1001st worker is billed at 85 percent. Exactly 5000 workers bill 1000 at the full fee and 4000 at 85 percent; at 5001 the last worker is billed at 70 percent.

## Worked figure (hypothetical fee of 3.00)

For 6200 enrolled workers: 1000 workers at 3.00 give 3000.00; 4000 workers at 2.55 give 10200.00; 1200 workers at 2.10 give 2520.00; in total 15720.00.
